description: This file defines a class named MidiInputPortSelector, which manages user selection of MIDI input ports within an Android application. It extends a base class MidiPortSelector and provides functionality to open MIDI input ports, retrieve MIDI receivers, and handle cleanup of resources.

classes.name: MidiInputPortSelector
classes.description: A class that manages a MIDI input port selector UI component, handling device opening, port access, and cleanup for MIDI input ports.

methods.name: MidiInputPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the selector with MIDI manager, activity context, and spinner ID, and specifying the port type as input.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles user selection of a MIDI port, opens the device and port asynchronously, and handles errors.

methods.name: getReceiver
methods.description: Returns the MidiReceiver associated with the opened input port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Closes the MIDI input port and device, releasing resources.
